crossRefs.note: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.
A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.
Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
Your words have supported him who was falling, You have made firm the feeble knees.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
“Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.
After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.
The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
Further, because the Preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge. Yes, he pondered, sought out, and set in…
The Preacher sought to find out acceptable words, and that which was written blamelessly, words of truth.
I will give you shepherds according to my heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.
Your words were found, and I ate them. Your words were to me a joy and the rejoicing of my heart, for I am called by…
So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than…
Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for…
because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of Yahweh.
Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you…
When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which…
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

translations.web: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.
translations.bsb: The lips of the righteous feed many, but fools die for lack of judgment.
translations.kjv: The lips of the righteous feed many: but fools die for want of wisdom.
translations.asv: The lips of the righteous feed many; But the foolish die for lack of understanding.
